item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem:
Rhea compares two packaged snacks using their nutrition labels.

Snack P: high calories, high fat, low protein, low dietary fibre.
Snack Q: fewer calories, lower fat, more protein, more dietary fibre.

Which claim correctly identifies the junk-food pattern?

options.A: Snack P better fits the junk-food pattern because it is high in calories and fat and low in protein and fibre.
options.B: Snack Q better fits the junk-food pattern because it has more protein and fibre.
options.C: Snack P cannot be junk food because it is sold in a packet.
options.D: Both snacks fit the junk-food pattern equally because both list calories.
